readout: FANA synthesis rate, normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent (fold)
assay_method: Polymerase kinetic profiling (PKPro). 20 nM polymerase, 1 uM 30-mer DNA template, 100 uM each NTP, 1x ThermoPol buffer, 2x LC Green Plus; denature 95 degC 3 min, extend 55 degC 30 min, fluorescence every 6 s; rate from a linear fit of nucleotides per polymerase vs time; mean of three independent replicates.
remark: No WT row: the readout is already normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent, which is 1.0 by definition. The reference sequence is the engineered Tgo-D4K parent, not native Tgo. Position 659 follows the source data, which carries Y and lists the variant as Y659E; the paper text instead calls it H659E. Q93A is listed twice with values differing by 7e-5, and the mean is used.

readout: Relative fitness under 128 ug/mL ampicillin at 25 C; higher is more resistant
assay_method: Bulk competition of a site-saturation library of VIM-2 in Escherichia coli E. cloni 10G. Single amino acid mutations were introduced with degenerate NNN codons by PCR across seven libraries of 39 consecutive codons each (33 for the last), sized for fully overlapping 150-bp paired-end Illumina NextSeq reads; two replicate selections were performed per library. The library was carried on the pIDR2 plasmid and selected for chloramphenicol resistance before being split for antibiotic selection. Per-variant relative fitness scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit.
remark: The assayed construct is UniProt Q5U7L7 with an extra Gly inserted after the initiator Met, which the methods state was added to create an NcoI cloning site, so positions here are one higher than native VIM-2 numbering from residue 2 onward; it also carries I at position 186 where every deposited VIM-2 reference has V, an allele difference rather than an engineered one. 267 nonsense rows are dropped, a premature stop not being writable as a substitution, and the 244 synonymous rows are the wild-type protein so they collapse to the single WT row at their mean, whose worst spread is 2.171. The readout is the deposit's relative fitness score used as it stands.
